item.text:
Audited the Roman transliteration verse by verse against the Urdu. The opening and all seven stanzas align. In stanza 6, changed `rauza-e-Athar` to `rauza-e-At-har` to distinguish the separate `t` and `h` sounds in اطہر. The Urdu and metadata were preserved.

Kept `Bober` in stanza 7 because it matches the existing poet spelling. Its pronunciation remains for editorial sign-off.
